text: dsh-storyboard 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的对话故事板插件，通过 profile bundle 注册系统提示、storyboard 工具和 /storyboard 命令。对话结束时，模型可调用工具，把本轮完成的工作、关键事实、步骤、时间线或工作机制整理成带内嵌 SVG 流程图的独立 HTML 文件，并保存到按会话区分的本地目录；用户也可用命令按需生成。适合希望回顾任务过程、查看可视化摘要的 DSH Web 用户。需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本；无需额外 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-storyboard adds a prompt, storyboard tool, and /storyboard command to DeepSeek Harness Web. It turns conversation steps, facts, or timelines into a local HTML recap with an inline SVG diagram. Requires Node.js 20+; no key or external service.
想把刚完成的 DSH 工作整理成一张可视化摘要。
能不能把对话中的步骤和关键事实做成 HTML 卡片？
Create a visual recap of my DSH conversation, including its workflow diagram.
dsh-storyboard 的功能「自动生成对话故事板」：提示模型在有实质内容的对话结束时调用工具，将标题、步骤、事实、时间线和机制要点渲染为独立 HTML，可选生成内嵌 SVG 流程图。自动触发由提示指导模型决定。
dsh-storyboard 的功能「按需生成摘要」：在聊天中输入 /storyboard，可附加关注主题；命令会排入后续消息，请求模型生成故事板，工具将结果保存到当前会话对应的本地目录。

dsh-storyboard README · dsh-storyboard：End-of-chat **Doubao-style visual storyboard** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web.

When a substantive conversation ends (real work done, a plan produced, or a concept explained), the model calls the `storyboard` tool once and a compact visual card summarizing **what was done and how it works** appears in the sidebar. A `/storyboard [focus]` command forces one on demand.

dsh-storyboard README · Why it is light：- **Server-only plugin** — no client bundle, no extra JS shipped to the browser.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — node built-ins only (`crypto`, `fs`, `os`, `path`).
- **One self-contained HTML file** per storyboard (~5–20 KB): system fonts, inline SVG, no network requests, no CDN, works offline.
- **Tiny prompt footprint** — the injected guidance section is ~500 characters.
- Storyboards are written under `$DSH_HOME/storyboard/<session>/` (default `~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/`).
dsh-storyboard README · from a workspace containing this folder:：dsh plugin --profile web add file:C:\path\to\dsh-storyboard

The bundle patch inserts one row (`id: storyboard`) into the web profile.
Disable it by removing that row from the profile (the prompt section, tool, and command are all registered by the row's presence).

dsh-storyboard README · Usage：1. **Automatic** — at the end of a substantive exchange the model generates the card and opens it in the sidebar by itself.
2. **On demand** — type `/storyboard` (optionally `/storyboard the install steps`) in the chat input.

dsh-storyboard README · Card sections：| Section | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Title / subtitle | `title`, `subtitle` | title required, max 40 / 80 chars |
| How it connects | `diagram` | ≤8 nodes, ≤12 edges, rendered as inline SVG with layered DAG layout + arrowheads |
| What was done | `flow` | ≤8 numbered steps with optional notes, connected by a vertical rail |
| Key facts | `facts` | ≤8 label/value pairs in a two-column grid |
| Timeline | `timeline` | ≤8 dotted-rail events with optional time labels |
| How it works | `howItWorks` | ≤8 mechanism bullet points |
dsh-storyboard README · Card sections：Every string is length-capped and HTML-escaped on the host side; omit a section when you have no content for it.

dsh-storyboard README · Development：```bash
node test/smoke.mjs   # standalone renderer + registration smoke test (no DSH host needed)
```

dsh-storyboard README · Limitations：- v1 has no settings toggle: presence of the profile row enables the feature.
- Diagram layout is a simple longest-path layering (cycles are capped, not drawn as true cycles).
- The automatic trigger is instruction-based (the model decides a conversation is ending); it is deliberately not a hard hook.
